brief_summary: This is a prospective, randomized, open label, parallel,4-month study to explore and evaluate the therapeutic effects of polyethylene glycol loxenatide on the cognitive function, olfactory function, and odor-induced brain activation in T2DM patients with normal cognitive status or MCI.
brief_title: Efficacy Comparison of Polyethylene Glycol Loxenatide and Gliclazide on the Brain Function in T2DM Patients

lead_sponsor.name: The Affiliated Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School

official_title: Efficacy Comparison of Polyethylene Glycol Loxenatide and Gliclazide on the Brain Function in T2DM Patients: a Randomized, Parallel Controlled Clinical Trial

primary_outcomes.measure: Change of olfactory brain activation by fMRI

sites.facility: Division of Endocrinology, the Affiliated Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University
